Pilgrimage and Medical Care Drive Indian Overnight Trips

Nearly one in two overnight trips taken by domestic tourists in India are for pilgrimage or religious purposes, according to data. Additionally, two in five overnight trips in rural India are for medical care, which is reported as the most expensive type of trip. Urban families are taking more holidays, while the percentage of rural households reporting overnight trips has decreased.
